headline: GestureFAR reports real-time continuous-latent streaming gestures on BEAT2
summary: A September 18 preprint proposes token-causal co-speech gesture generation using continuous motion latents and a flow-matching head, then distills only that head to one step while freezing the causal backbone. On BEAT2, the authors report a 3.08 FGD one-step student at 9.3 ms/token, compared with 3.17 at 24.4 ms/token for their eight-step teacher, and 0.246 real-time factor on a MacBook Air. These are author-reported results for a specialized avatar/embodied-agent benchmark; no independent reproduction or deployment transfer is established.
